note: Public pay-as-you-go list prices read from the vendors' pricing pages on the as_of date. Enterprise contracts, promotions and plan allowances differ: copy this file, edit the numbers, and point PRICING_FILE at your copy. Costs the engine shows are estimates built from measured quantities x these prices.
usd_inr_note: USD to INR used for the rupee totals; set USD_INR in .env to today's rate.
carrier_note: Plivo India voice ₹0.38/min with audio streaming included, 30-second billing pulse (plivo.com/voice/pricing/in). Vobiz ₹0.65/min for WebSocket streaming per its own comparison page. Set to your contracted rates.

deepgram/flux-general-multi.billing: true per-second billing on audio streamed, silence included

deepgram/flux-general-en.billing: regular rate; $0.0065 promotional on the page

deepgram/nova-3.billing: multilingual streaming rate (monolingual is $0.0048); true per-second billing

google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite.billing: text input (audio input is $0.30/M); thinking tokens billed as output, counted from the total

google/gemini-2.5-flash.billing: thinking tokens are billed as output (counted here from the total)

google/gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-pre.billing: Live API native audio; audio is about 25 tokens per second

google/gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview.billing: assumed same as the 2.5 native-audio Live rate; verify on the pricing page

cartesia/sonic-3.billing: 1 credit = 1 character; $38 per 1M credits is the Scale-plan overage rate (Startup $45, Pro $65); plan allowances are prepaid

elevenlabs/eleven_flash_v2_5.billing: $0.04 per 1k characters (Flash/Turbo); plan allowances are prepaid
